mechanism: Uncleaned module-level subscription holding closure scope

evidence.claim: useEffect adds subscriber closure (which retains payload) to module-scoped messageSubscribers Set without returning a cleanup function to delete it on unmount.

recommendedFix: Return a cleanup function from useEffect that deletes subscriber from messageSubscribers and updates activeResources/retainedResources count.
limitations: Static code analysis only; no runtime heap measurements performed.
